action_inputs.description: Address to send the test to; defaults to the CloudBolt admin email.
action_inputs.label: Recipient (optional)
action_inputs.name: onb_smtp_to

label: POC Onboarding: SMTP Test
mcp_tool_description: Send a test email through the saved SMTP settings (to onb_smtp_to, else the CloudBolt admin email, else the caller's address) and return the relay's real error with a hint when it fails. Call it after onb_smtp and after the user entered the password in the UI. Runs as a job: poll the returned id with fetch_job. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
